svg.title: DeepScientist — editable manual vector redraw of AutoFigure case 11
svg.desc: Hand-authored by Codex from the user-provided reference image. Colored pictograms are simplified original vectors. This is not output from the automatic reconstruction request, which timed out without response headers. Thirty logical relation requirements and the original overview/detail structure guided this drawing. No segmentation API, image generation or remote resources are used.
